propositions: The rebar metrics subcommand must parse --since/--until date-range arguments and --output json|text format flags, then evaluate and render every MetricSpec in the full registry over the specified range with no bucketing or filtering.

The metrics.py entry point must import the rebar.metrics package (not just the registry module) to ensure reader registration side-effects hydrate REGISTRY before evaluating specs, and must construct a context object carrying repo_root, since, and until for each compute callable.

The render loop must wrap each registry.evaluate(spec, ctx) call in try/except to handle compute failures gracefully, rendering unavailable metrics with error reasons rather than crashing the command; every registered metric id must appear in output.

JSON output (default) must emit {"since": str, "until": str, "metrics": {id: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}, ...}} with lens from spec and metadata from evaluate result; text output must list one metric per line in registry order.

The dispatch wiring must add an explicit if sub == "metrics": arm in _dispatch() that routes the command to the reads path after store initialization, mirroring init/scratch, and test_help_overview_coverage must add "metrics" to its individual frozenset.
The metrics.py source must not import rebar.metrics.adapters to maintain adapter isolation; a source-level scan test must verify this portability guard.
